scope: Technical grounding for the five revised fictional puzzles; no claim of a new independent Impossible Quiz playthrough.

sources.observed: Strong applies importance to its contents; ancestry matters. Visual styling is separate from semantics.
sources.adaptation: Four fixed authored trees, rendered and inspected from the same data. This is a typography/markup joke, not a claim about password entropy.

sources.observed: Extending a basic volume requires immediately following unallocated space on the same disk.
sources.adaptation: A fictional twelve-block disk allows reversible relocation of TOOLS. Its controls are not a complete Windows Disk Management reproduction; no real drive is altered.

sources.observed: IPv4 forwarding decrements TTL; reaching zero discards the packet. Receiving a packet addressed to an endpoint is distinct from forwarding it.
sources.adaptation: A fixed forwarding graph distinguishes three Layer 2 switches from an IP router. The graph supplies the relevant rules; no real routes or remote traffic are involved.

sources.observed: Search-index evidence describes cancellation at printer control panel, software application, or Windows print queue.
sources.availability: Direct page fetch returned HTTP403; no unavailable full text is claimed as reviewed.
sources.adaptation: Separate PC and printer queues are an explicitly authored deterministic simulation. Page labels deliberately disagree with document order; exact supplied page bytes determine output.

sources.observed: Capture data and its displayed view are distinct concepts.
sources.adaptation: The source switch, FIFO drain and paused monitor are explicitly fictional recorder rules, not a reproduction of Wireshark or a claim about real audio-recording Pause behavior. Only fixed dummy samples are processed.

presentation: Original frozen 2007 reference artwork, music, effects, first-party mature start cue and certificate remain unchanged. New printer/network/storage props are authored DOM/SVG/CSS in the approved visual style. No external raster art or audio was added.

limits: Hard–Very Hard remains a target pending independent human playtesting. Technical source verification does not establish enjoyment or anti-agent effectiveness.
